description: I'm André Amaral Borges. I build websites and apps, from online stores and restaurant sites to real-time chat, automation tools, and an SDG dashboard. I work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and deployment, with a focus on design and usability. I enjoy figuring things out and turning ideas into something people can use. I want to join the team to learn from people with different skills, contribute wherever needed, and build something we're proud to demo.
